args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Retail Returns Logistics (Newsletter + Article + Companion)
args.body:
- Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to their blog article and a companion insights piece.
- Article: apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
- Companion piece: resale within 10 days kept most of the margin.
